summary: Learn to assess clinical data risks, document safeguards, and improve analytics privacy workflows. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Healthcare analytics privacy training helps clinical analysts protect clinical data while supporting responsible analysis. For health informatics officers and security practitioners, it offers practical methods to map data flows and risks, assess access and minimization needs, and document de-identification decisions. Learners also review sharing and disclosure controls and prepare audit, incident-response, and reporting workflows for clinical records and imaging data.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle clinical data, operate analytics workflows, or review the privacy and security controls around them. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical methods for protecting health information without assuming a coding background.
modules: NIST Privacy Framework and Clinical Data
Clinical Data Sharing and Audit Trails
prerequisites: No formal privacy, cybersecurity, or programming background is required. Familiarity with clinical data workflows can help you connect the exercises to your work. Coding is not required.
